name: local-mcp
description: Give Codex access to your own Mac or Windows apps through LMCP, a local MCP server: Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Messages, Teams, Slack, WhatsApp, OneDrive, Office documents and local files. Tools run on your computer; no API keys to manage.

interface.shortDescription: Your Mac or Windows apps, as tools for Codex
interface.longDescription: LMCP is a local MCP server that lets Codex work with Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Messages, Teams, Slack, WhatsApp, OneDrive, Office documents and local files on your computer. Install the LMCP app first; the plugin starts its MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Search my email for the latest invoice and summarize it
